verzen.tekst: He brought out of him a man of mercy,
verzen.html: He brought out of him a man of mercy,

verzen.tekst: He made him equal to the glory of the saints,
verzen.html: He made him equal to the glory of the saints,

verzen.tekst: By his words he caused the wonders to cease.
verzen.html: By his words he caused the wonders to cease.

verzen.tekst: He sanctified him in his faithfulness and meekness.
verzen.html: He sanctified him in his faithfulness and meekness.

verzen.tekst: He made him to hear his voice,
verzen.html: He made him to hear his voice,

verzen.tekst: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like Moses,
verzen.html: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like Moses,

verzen.tekst: He established an everlasting covenant with him,
verzen.html: He established an everlasting covenant with him,

verzen.tekst: He clothed him in perfect splendour,
verzen.html: He clothed him in perfect splendour,

verzen.tekst: He encircled him with pomegranates;
verzen.html: He encircled him with pomegranates;

verzen.tekst: with a holy garment, with gold, blue, and purple, the work of the embroiderer;
verzen.html: with a holy garment, with gold, blue, and purple, the work of the embroiderer;

verzen.tekst: with twisted scarlet, the work of the craftsman;
verzen.html: with twisted scarlet, the work of the craftsman;

verzen.tekst: with a crown of gold upon the mitre, having engraved on it, as on a signet, “HOLINESS”,
verzen.html: with a crown of gold upon the mitre, having engraved on it, as on a signet, “HOLINESS”,

verzen.tekst: Before him there never have been anything like it.
verzen.html: Before him there never have been anything like it.

verzen.tekst: His sacrifices shall be wholly burnt,

verzen.tekst: Moses consecrated him,
verzen.html: Moses consecrated him,

verzen.html: He chose him out of all living

verzen.tekst: He gave to him in his commandments,
verzen.html: He gave to him in his commandments,

verzen.html: Strangers conspired against him

verzen.tekst: The Lord saw it, and it displeased him.

verzen.tekst: He added glory to Aaron,
verzen.html: He added glory to Aaron,

verzen.tekst: For they eat the sacrifices of the Lord,

verzen.tekst: However, in the land of the people, he has no inheritance,

verzen.tekst: Also he made a covenant with David the son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah.
verzen.html: Also he made a covenant with David the son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah.
